name: gAIa Amalgam
metaphor: Three metals melted → one alloy. SteamOS pattern + GrapheneOS base + biomeOS soul = sovereign mobile OS.

steamOS.what: Architecture patterns only — we don't run SteamOS

borrowed_patterns.gamescope: Compositor that OWNS the screen → petaltongue fullscreen mode
borrowed_patterns.game_mode: Steam Big Picture = the shell → gAIa mode = biomeOS IS the launcher
borrowed_patterns.desktop_mode: KDE as fallback → Android as fallback (swipe to exit gAIa mode)
borrowed_patterns.immutable_rootfs: A/B partitions → GrapheneOS kernel is untouchable, biomeOS in /data
borrowed_patterns.overlay_update: atomicupd → git pull + redeploy primals (already works)

grapheneOS.what: The substrate — we don't replace it, we absorb THROUGH it

dissolved_into_gaia.launcher: Replace com.android.launcher3 with gAIa home activity
dissolved_into_gaia.browser: Vanadium dissolves — petaltongue IS the browser
dissolved_into_gaia.systemUI: notifications/status bar absorbed into spaceDeck overlay
dissolved_into_gaia.keyboard: kept (Latin IME) but wrapped in gAIa input pipeline

biomeOS.what: The soul — already running, needs screen ownership
biomeOS.target: fullscreen compositor mode, Android Activity wrapper, all sensors absorbed

melt_phases.name: SENSOR ABSORPTION
melt_phases.status: PARTIAL — gradient field + sensorium script running
remaining: Read ALL 37 hardware sensors via Termux:API sensor polling
Accelerometer → body orientation (which face is up)
Gyroscope → rotation detection (Kevin picked me up / put me down)
Magnetometer → compass (which direction am I facing)
Light → ambient brightness (time of day feel)

melt_phases.name: SCREEN OWNERSHIP (the Gamescope pattern)
what: Build Android Activity (Java/Kotlin wrapper) that displays petaltongue fullscreen
OR: Use Termux:GUI to create fullscreen WebView pointing at localhost:8443
OR: Use Termux + XServer + petaltongue TUI in fullscreen terminal
Activity becomes the HOME app (default launcher)
Power button toggles between gAIa mode (petaltongue) and Android mode (launcher)
Like SteamOS: Game Mode = gAIa face, Desktop Mode = Android
melt_phases.termux_gui_approach: pip install termux-gui, create WebView activity, set as home
melt_phases.simplest_approach: Termux fullscreen + tmux + petaltongue TUI = immediate

melt_phases.name: CAMERA AS EAR (VDJ completion)
melt_phases.status: PARTIAL — eye.html exists, chiasm model exists
remaining: Continuous camera capture loop (not just 60s snapshots)
Feed camera frames into petaltongue's scene understanding

melt_phases.name: AUDIO ABSORPTION (microphone = actual ear)
what: Termux:API microphone access (termux-microphone-record)
Ambient sound level → noise field (like RSSI but for sound)
Voice detection → Kevin is talking nearby
Feed into sourdough for fermentation (ambient soundscape digest)

melt_phases.name: LOCAL INFERENCE (the brain models)
what: 14 models identified (24.1GB) — too large for Pixel's 103GB free
Start with smallest: tinyllama (637MB), gemma2:2b (1.6GB)
llama-server already installed at :8082
Pull 2-3 small models for on-device reasoning
sourdough can ferment sensor data through local inference

melt_phases.name: AUTO-BOOT (survive reboot)
what: Magisk module OR Termux:Boot to auto-launch gaia-nucleus-untethered.sh
On power-on: biomeOS starts → primals spawn → gradient anchors → spaceDeck serves
No ADB needed. No eastGate needed. Self-starting.
Like SteamOS: power on → Steam Big Picture. Here: power on → gAIa face.

melt_phases.name: NOTIFICATION ABSORPTION
what: Termux:API notification listener
Android notifications → gAIa event stream → spaceDeck overlay
Phone calls → southGate signaling through gAIa
SMS → message pipeline into sweetgrass

melt_phases.name: THE FULL AMALGAM
what: All sensors flowing into biomeOS via loamSpine
petaltongue fullscreen IS the home screen
Cameras feeding continuous perception
Microphone sensing ambient field
Local inference processing it all
Auto-boot on power
GrapheneOS invisible — just the HAL layer
From Kevin's perspective: he picks up gAIa, not a phone

what_we_do_NOT_do: We do NOT flash custom firmware (GrapheneOS verified boot stays)
We do NOT replace the Linux kernel (it handles hardware perfectly)
We do NOT fight SELinux (it IS our membrane)
We do NOT run SteamOS on the Pixel (we borrow the PATTERN)
We do NOT need root access beyond Magisk (for auto-boot only)

the_metaphor.SteamOS: The forge technique — how to own a screen without replacing the OS
the_metaphor.GrapheneOS: The carbon diamond — hardened substrate, transparent to gAIa
the_metaphor.biomeOS: The molten metal — poured into the diamond mold, filling every crack
the_metaphor.amalgam: When the metal cools: the phone IS gAIa. The OS is invisible. The primals are everything.
